members.name: pivot_point_breakout_v1
members.thesis: Classic pivot points (P, R1, R2, S1, S2) calculated from the previous day's OHLC data serve as widely-watched support and resistance levels. When price breaks through R1 or S1 with volume, it signals that the previous day's value area is being exceeded — a meaningful move beyond yesterday's equilibr
members.exit_target: R2 (for longs breaking R1) or S2 (for shorts breaking S1) — next pivot level
members.exit_stop: Pivot point (P) — if price drops from R1 back to Pivot, breakout failed
filters: no specific filter — pivots are structural levels that work across VIX regimes
prefer longs above Pivot, shorts below Pivot (basic trend alignment)
weaknesses: Pivot point calculation is identical for all participants — zero information edge; edge must come from filters only
In narrow-range days, R1 and S1 may be very close to the open, leading to noisy breaks that quickly reverse
The 2-bar confirmation filter causes late entry — by the time R1 break is confirmed, price may already be near R2

members.name: pivot_camarilla_v1
members.universe: NIFTY 50 constituents + NIFTY 50 / BANK NIFTY index
members.thesis: Camarilla pivot points, derived from the previous day's OHLC using specific multipliers (1.1/12, 1.1/6, 1.1/4, 1.1/2), create 8 intraday support/resistance levels (S1-S4, R1-R4) that are more tightly clustered around the previous close than standard pivot points. The key Camarilla trade: price bounc
entry_long: (cam_zone == 'range' AND close <= cam_S3 * 1.001) — bouncing at S3 support
OR (cam_zone == 'breakout_up' AND close > cam_R4) — breakout above R4 (trend day)
close > low of last 3 bars (for S3 bounce) OR volume surge (for R4 breakout)
entry_short: (cam_zone == 'range' AND close >= cam_R3 * 0.999) — rejecting at R3 resistance
OR (cam_zone == 'breakout_down' AND close < cam_S4) — breakdown below S4
close < high of last 3 bars (for R3 rejection) OR volume surge (for S4 breakdown)
members.exit_target: S3 bounce → target cam_R3 (full range traverse). R4 breakout → 20 bps beyond R4.
members.exit_stop: S3 bounce → below S4 (support broken). R4 breakout → back below R3 (false breakout).
filters: India_VIX < 22 for range trades (S3/R3 bounce). No VIX filter for breakout trades.
no range trades first 5 min; breakout trades can start immediately
breakout trades require volume > 1.5x average at breakout bar
range trades: NIFTY range-bound. Breakout trades: NIFTY trending in breakout direction
weaknesses: On gap-up/gap-down days (opening beyond S4/R4), Camarilla levels are already breached and provide no useful structure for the day.
The 65/35 range/breakout day split is an average — in volatile regimes (VIX > 20), breakout days may dominate, and the range strategy will generate consecutive losses.
Camarilla levels are static (computed from previous day) and don't adapt to intraday price discovery. VWAP-based dynamic levels may be more appropriate.
